purpose: Teach: 輪廻/撃沈/怒涛/凱旋/建立/警備隊/生まれつき/オウム真理教

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、輪廻思想の宗教史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the religious history of reincarnation in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Curious, encouraging. Eyes bright. Leaning forward slightly with genuine interest in his answer. Warm pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下に船舶が撃沈された事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually focused on wartime cases of ships being sunk.
lines.style: Quiet and steady. A slight pause before answering, like he's gathering his thoughts. Measured delivery, no apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代国家の怒涛のような近代化を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the fierce modernization wave of the modern nation-state in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle prompt. A slight tilt of the head. Giving him space to correct or clarify. Interested in where he's actually going.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、将軍の凱旋史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the history of the general's triumphant campaigns.
lines.style: Still steady. A touch more confident now. Not rushing. Letting each phrase land clearly without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、大寺院の建立史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you tackled the architectural history of the great temples in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Noticing the pattern now, perhaps slightly amused. A warmth underneath — she sees him working hard. Engaged, present attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時警備隊の組織研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my focus was on the organizational structure of wartime security units.
lines.style: A small shift here. Still measured, but there's a thread of quiet determination. He knows these answers matter. No rush, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生まれつきの障害を持つ方の社会参加史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the social history of people living with congenital disabilities, didn't you?
lines.style: This one gentler. She's testing something — watching his face. Slower pace. Genuine curiosity about where this is heading.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、オウム真理教事件の社会的影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the social impact of the Aum Shinrikyo incident.
lines.style: A small closing. Still calm but there's a finality to it. He's answered. Waiting. Not uncomfortable in the quiet.
